comment: Book of Stray Minutes, page 4 of 12: childhood and school days. The reward is a small keepsake, a gold paper star (one of the page's own minutes).

reward.text: For a moment your hands feel smaller, holding the finished page of Minutes from Being Small. A gold paper star has come loose from one of its minutes, and it is yours to keep.

do.name: gold paper star
do.seed: a small gold paper star, the kind pressed on beside good work; its points are a little bent from being pressed on so proudly

collectibles.name: the loose-tooth minute
collectibles.text: a loose tooth wiggled with the tip of the tongue, brave and not quite brave enough

collectibles.name: the shoelace minute
collectibles.text: the very first bow that stayed tied

collectibles.name: the chalk-dust minute
collectibles.text: just before the bell, when the classroom smelled of chalk and rain-damp coats

collectibles.name: the gold-star minute
collectibles.text: a gold paper star pressed on beside a page of careful handwriting

collectibles.name: the hide-and-seek minute
collectibles.text: a giggle held in behind the long curtains while the seeker walked right past

collectibles.name: the top-of-the-swing minute
collectibles.text: the top of the swing, where for one heartbeat you weighed nothing at all

collectibles.name: the grazed-knee minute
collectibles.text: a grazed knee being blown on, which somehow made it better

collectibles.name: the late-answer minute
collectibles.text: the right answer arriving a second after the teacher had moved on

collectibles.name: the register minute
collectibles.text: your name in the morning register, and a 'here' that came out in a wobble

collectibles.name: the conker minute
collectibles.text: a conker split from its spiky case, so shiny it looked wet

collectibles.name: the doorframe minute
collectibles.text: a pencil line drawn above your head on the kitchen doorframe, higher than the last one

collectibles.name: the daisy-chain minute
collectibles.text: a daisy chain long enough, at last, to go all the way round

collectibles.name: the den minute
collectibles.text: a den of blankets and chairs, a lantern inside, and the flap let down

collectibles.name: the cartwheel minute
collectibles.text: a cartwheel that finally landed the right way up, witnessed by nobody at all
